boardwalk.name: Boardwalk
boardwalk.identity: Tourist coast, diner lights, old pier and public beach.
boardwalk.ambient: Bright mornings, busy evenings, quiet after midnight.

old_quarter.name: Old Quarter
old_quarter.identity: Dense low-rise streets, repair shops, family businesses and narrow alleys.
old_quarter.ambient: Warm shop lights, local radio, close pedestrian spaces.

downtown.name: Downtown
downtown.identity: Glass towers, civic buildings, rooftop routes and corporate plazas.
downtown.ambient: Traffic hum, neon signage and distant sirens.

harbor.name: Harbor
harbor.identity: Container yards, piers, cranes, warehouses and restricted roads.
harbor.ambient: Foggy dawns, sodium lamps, gulls and industrial machinery.

night_market.name: Night Market
night_market.identity: Covered stalls, music venues, food alleys and informal information networks.
night_market.ambient: Dense colour and sound; keep crowds as impostors or pooled low-cost agents.

industrial_belt.name: Industrial Belt
industrial_belt.identity: Repair depots, scrap yards, service roads and power infrastructure.
industrial_belt.ambient: Large silhouettes, long sightlines, few active NPCs.

canal.name: Canal District
canal.identity: Quiet waterside paths, footbridges, apartments and community gardens.
canal.ambient: Calm daytime routes and reflective night lighting.

outskirts.name: Outskirts
outskirts.identity: Abandoned service facilities, coastal road and scrubland beyond the city.
outskirts.ambient: Sparse geometry, wide vistas, very low NPC density.
